# Graph message-size lookup distinguishes missing values from malformed properties

The original size lookup parses an Integer property as i32, then uses a fallible unsigned conversion and a zero fallback. A negative parsed value or missing match can therefore fall back, while malformed numeric text and a missing original map collection key propagate errors. Accepted typed fields later turn an absent collection into None. Keep that later absence behavior separate from the original Result-returning getter; no malformed response or network sync was executed.

Scope: Graph single-value extended-property size conversion.
